text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the conclusion of the Shuntaisai 
Training Camp, 
a message arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amazingly, they've agreed to lend us 
the grounds for a little longer, all for <chrname> 
's sake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we were able to extend 
our Shuntaisai Training Camp beyond what 
was originally planned!
